actions.name: Generate Copy
actions.prompt: Write a 3-email cold outreach sequence for {{row.first_name}} {{row.last_name}} ({{row.title}}) at {{row.company_name}}. Tech stack: {{row.tech_stack}}. Recent news: {{row.recent_news}}. Industry: {{row.industry}}. Rules: Email 1 = 3-4 sentences. Email 2 (Day 2) = 2-3 sentences. Email 3 (Day 5) = 1-2 sentences. No hype, no buzzwords. Conversational tone. Return JSON only, no extra text: {"subject": "", "body_email1": "", "body_email2": "", "body_email3": "", "copy_status": "done"}
